title: Renames the `platform_payments` capability for accounts to `card_payments`, requiring the manual specification of the added `transfers` capability
migrationNotes: This change renames the platform_payments capability to transfers and decouples it from the card_payments capability. You now need to explicitly request the transfers capability when creating an account, even if they also request card_payments. This modification provides clearer terminology and more granular control over account capabilities.
